rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being intoxicated by alcohol, with 成日 understood or added when the sense is habitual.

example.english: I drank too much last night and got completely drunk.
example.traditional: 我噚晚飲多咗，成個人醉晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 jam2 do1 zo2 seng4 go3 jan4 zeoi3 saai3

rows.note: Use this when success, power, or excitement makes someone elated and overconfident rather than literally intoxicated.

example.english: He got drunk with success after winning the competition and went around saying he was the best.
example.traditional: 佢一贏咗比賽就得意忘形，周圍話自己最叻。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jeng4 zo2 bei2 coi3 zau6 dak1 ji3 mong4 jing4 zau1 wai4 waa6 zi6 gei2 zeoi3 lek1
